rv.q: Under Church’s vision, it gives us something even better: an unapologetic representation of female empowerment.
This play isn't going to rock your world but if you're looking for a light, funny summer comedy this is the show for you.
It is a light, bright summer entertainment -- very, very old-fashioned, but respectfully and respectably done.

cn.t: This 100-year-old comedy about a strong-willed woman who takes charge of her life earns praise for its surprisingly progressive themes, though some find it old-fashioned. Critics call it a warm, boisterous crowd-pleaser with vivid characters.
